answer.text: A mutual fund scheme launched by SEBI
An aggregating mutual fund transaction/service platform promoted by KFintech and CAMS, similar to MF Utilities, that connects investors and mutual fund ecosystem participants
The office of AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds in India)
A stock exchange for trading mutual fund units

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, MF Central is an aggregating platform launched/promoted by KFintech and CAMS, similar to MF Utilities, and is grouped with MF Utilities as a platform connecting investors with RTAs, distributors, banks, and AMCs. The Trap: MFCentral is not a SEBI-launched scheme, not AMFI's office, and not a stock exchange — those distractors mischaracterise the platform's nature and sponsors. Note: The checked V-B pages describe MF Central at the level of aggregation/connection across ecosystem participants. Specific service menus (CAS download, redemptions, portfolio tracking, bank mandates, KYC update, website/app channels) are not enumerated on the checked workbook pages and should not be stated as workbook-supported features.
